title: The Unanswered Message
summary: Tae-Jun's recorded holographic hologram reveals the conspiracy behind their parents' deaths, Section 9's forbidden Project Chimera, and the true reason he sacrificed his freedom.

panels.shot: holographic blue-red light illuminating the dusty bedroom
panels.action: The entire bedroom is bathed in flickering holographic beams as Tae-Jun's 3D projection speaks.
panels.prose_en: The entire bedroom is bathed in flickering holographic beams as Tae-Jun's 3D projection speaks.
panels.prose_hi: Jaisa ki taaye-jun ka 3d prakshepan bolta hai, pura shyankaksh timtimati holographic kiranon se nahaya hua hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram sitting on an iron chair recording
panels.action: The hologram shows Tae-Jun sitting in an underground concrete bunker with emergency red sirens flashing behind him.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mere paas zyada waqt nahi hai. Section 9 ke Hunter strike teams ne perimeter break kar diya hai.

panels.prose_en: The hologram shows Tae-Jun sitting in an underground concrete bunker with emergency red sirens flashing behind him.
panels.prose_hi: Hologram mein taaye-jun ko ek bhumigat concrete bunker mein baithe hue dikhaya gaya hai aur uske peeche aapatkalin lal siren chamak rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping closer holding his breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes two quiet steps forward, mesmerized by every flicker of his brother's voice.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes two quiet steps forward, mesmerized by every flicker of his brother's voice.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne bhai ki awaaz ki har jhilmilahat se mantramugdh hokar do shant kadam aage badhata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram touching his bandaged throat
panels.action: Tae-Jun adjusts a collar hiding a glowing red tracking seal around his neck: 'Dad was the chief archivist for the Sovereign relics.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dad ordinary human nahi the. He was a Guardian who swore to protect the First Sovereign's bloodline.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun adjusts a collar hiding a glowing red tracking seal around his neck: 'Dad was the chief archivist for the Sovereign relics.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apni gardan ke charon or chamakti lal tracking seal ko chhipate hue ek collar ko samayojit karta hai: 'pitaji samprabhu avsheshon ke liye mukhya puralekhpal the.'

panels.shot: flashback shard: father studying ancient scrolls
panels.action: A holographic memory insert shows their father, Kang Min-Soo, deciphering ancient demonic tablets by candlelight.
panels.prose_en: A holographic memory insert shows their father, Kang Min-Soo, deciphering ancient demonic tablets by candlelight.
panels.prose_hi: Ek holographic memory insert mein unke pita, kang min-su ko mombatti ki roshni mein prachin rakshasi goliyon ko samajhte hue dikhaya gaya hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun explaining the hunter association corruption
panels.action: Tae-Jun: 'When Chairman Song learned of Dad's bloodline, he demanded Dad surrender the relics to weaponize them.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Chairman Song human world ko protect nahi karna chahta tha. He wanted to harvest Sovereign cores!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun: 'When Chairman Song learned of Dad's bloodline, he demanded Dad surrender the relics to weaponize them.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun: 'jab chairman song ko pitaji ke vansh ke baare mein pata chala, to unhone mang ki ki pitaji avsheshon ko hathiyar banane ke liye unhen saunp den.'

panels.shot: flashback shard: burning car and black rain on expressway
panels.action: A holographic reconstruction of the night seven years ago: black hunter tactical trucks ramming their parents' car off Mapo Bridge.
panels.prose_en: A holographic reconstruction of the night seven years ago: black hunter tactical trucks ramming their parents' car off Mapo Bridge.
panels.prose_hi: Saat saal pehle ki raat ka ek holographic punarnirman: mepo bridge ke paas kale shikari samrik truckon ne apne mata-pita ki car ko takkar maar di.

panels.shot: ha-jun fists trembling with dark purple lightning
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingernails dig into his palms until blood beads; purple mana sparks uncontrollably from his skin.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ek car accident... Humne saat saal tak yahi jhooth sach maana!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingernails dig into his palms until blood beads; purple mana sparks uncontrollably from his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke nakhun uski hatheliyon mein khoon ke moti tak gad jaate han; uski tvacha se baingani maina aniyantrit roop se chamakti hai.

panels.shot: min-jae looking down in shared grief and shame
panels.action: Min-Jae bites his lip: 'Chairman Song... The whole Hunter Association celebrated him as a hero while he murdered his own guardians.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: This is sick... The entire association was built on stolen blood.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae bites his lip: 'Chairman Song... The whole Hunter Association celebrated him as a hero while he murdered his own guardians.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne apne honth kate: 'chairman song... poore hunter association ne use ek nayak ke roop mein manaya, jabki usne apne hi abhibhavakon ki hatya kar di thi.'

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram coughing up digital static blood
panels.action: The hologram flickers violently; Tae-Jun wipes crimson blood from his mouth: 'My bloodline awakened when Dad died.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dad ke marne par mera bloodline jaaga. But I only inherited the Guardian's Shield, not the Throne.

panels.prose_en: The hologram flickers violently; Tae-Jun wipes crimson blood from his mouth: 'My bloodline awakened when Dad died.'.
panels.prose_hi: Hologram tivrata se timtimata hai; taaye-jun apne munh se gehra khoon ponchte han: 'jab pitaji ki mrityu hui to meri raktdhara jaag gai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun holding up a glowing bronze crest in hologram
panels.action: In the projection, Tae-Jun shows a heavy bronze talisman inscribed with an interlocking dragon and feather crest.
panels.prose_en: In the projection, Tae-Jun shows a heavy bronze talisman inscribed with an interlocking dragon and feather crest.
panels.prose_hi: Prakshepan men, taaye-jun ek bhari kansya tabij dikhata hai jis par ek interlocking dragon aur pankh ki shikha ankit hai.

panels.shot: kuro spreading black wings in stunned confirmation
panels.action: Kuro croaks with deep respect: 'The Aegis of Tartarus. The shield that protects the Sovereign from premature birth.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wo sacred shield Tae-Jun ke paas thi. He bore the burden so you could grow up safe.

panels.prose_en: Kuro croaks with deep respect: 'The Aegis of Tartarus. The shield that protects the Sovereign from premature birth.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro gahre samman ke saath chillata hai: 'd agis off tarters. wah dhal jo samprabhu ko samay se pehle janm se bachati hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram looking intensely into the camera lens
panels.action: Tae-Jun speaks as if looking straight into Ha-Jun's soul: 'Ha-Jun, Section 9's scanners were locking onto our apartment.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Agar main wahan rukta, toh wo tumhe le jaate. Tum 10 saal ke the. You wouldn't survive their surgical tests.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun speaks as if looking straight into Ha-Jun's soul: 'Ha-Jun, Section 9's scanners were locking onto our apartment.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun aise bolta hai mano sidhe ha-jun ki aatma mein dekh raha ho: 'ha-jun, dhara 9 ke scanner hamare apartment par tala laga rahe the.'

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram smiling with heartbroken tenderness
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles softly, tears glistening in his eyes: 'So I flared my own mana to the maximum and led them away into Incheon harbor.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Maine apna pura mana burst kiya taaki wo soche main aakhri survivor hoon. I drew every hunter to me.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles softly, tears glistening in his eyes: 'So I flared my own mana to the maximum and led them away into Incheon harbor.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun dheere se muskurate han, unki aankhon mein aansu chamakte han: 'to maine apne man ko adhiktam tak bhadkaya aur unhen inchiyon bandargah mein le gaya.'

panels.shot: ha-jun collapsing to his knees sobbing silently
panels.action: Ha-Jun sinks to his knees onto the wooden floorboards, his forehead touching the floor as tears soak the dust.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne mere liye apni puri zindagi kurban kar di... Aur main sochta tha tum mujhe chhod gaye...

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sinks to his knees onto the wooden floorboards, his forehead touching the floor as tears soak the dust.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun lakdi ke farshbord par apne ghutnon ke bal baith jata hai, uska matha farsh ko chhuta hai kyonki aansu dhul ko sokh lete han.

panels.shot: min-jae kneeling beside ha-jun resting hand on back
panels.action: Min-Jae kneels beside Ha-Jun in brotherly solidarity, his own eyes wet with tears.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae kneels beside Ha-Jun in brotherly solidarity, his own eyes wet with tears.
panels.prose_hi: Bhaichare ki ekjutta ke saath min-je ha-jun ke paas ghutne tekata hai, uski apni aankhen aansuon se gili ho jaati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram warning about dr. victor vance
panels.action: Tae-Jun's voice turns grim: 'Watch out for Dr. Victor Vance. He ran Project Chimera in Vault 7.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dr. Vance insaan nahi raha. He injects synthetic demon cores into human candidates.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's voice turns grim: 'Watch out for Dr. Victor Vance. He ran Project Chimera in Vault 7.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ki awaaz gambhir ho jaati hai: 'do. victor vens se savdhan rahen. unhone walt 7 mein project chimera chalaya.

panels.shot: hologram showing schematics of synthetic demon cores
panels.action: A blue schematic rotates: a mechanical core containing liquid violet demon blood hooked to human nerve clusters.
panels.prose_en: A blue schematic rotates: a mechanical core containing liquid violet demon blood hooked to human nerve clusters.
panels.prose_hi: Ek neela yojanabaddh ghumta hai: ek yantrik core jisme taral baingani danav rakt hota hai jo manav tantrika samuhon se juda hota hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun hologram warning about the nine relics
panels.action: Tae-Jun: 'The relics aren't weapons, Ha-Jun. They are keys. When all ten gather, the Sovereign Throne opens.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Das relics sirf hathiyar nahi hain. They are the keys to seal the Primordial Void forever.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun: 'The relics aren't weapons, Ha-Jun. They are keys. When all ten gather, the Sovereign Throne opens.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun: 'avshesh hathiyar nahin han, ha-jun. ve chabiyan han. jab sabhi das ikatthe hote han, to samprabhu sinhasan khul jata hai.'

panels.shot: sounds of explosions in background of holographic audio
panels.action: Heavy thuds and gunfire rattle through the hologram's microphone; red warning lights flash faster.
panels.prose_en: Heavy thuds and gunfire rattle through the hologram's microphone; red warning lights flash faster.
panels.prose_hi: Hologram ke microphone mein bhari gadgdahat aur goliyon ki gadgdahat hoti hai; lal chetavani battiyan teji se chamakti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun drawing his blade in the recording
panels.action: In the video, Tae-Jun stands up, unsheathing a broken silver shortsword as door hinges buckle behind him.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Wo andar aa chuke hain. Mujhe yeh recording shut karni hogi.

panels.prose_en: In the video, Tae-Jun stands up, unsheathing a broken silver shortsword as door hinges buckle behind him.
panels.prose_hi: Wedio men, taaye-jun khada hota hai, aur uske peeche darvaje ka buckle bandha hua hota hai aur wah tuti hui chandi ki shortsward ko kholta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking one last time with infinite brotherly love
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks into the camera lens with unconditional warmth: 'Happy tenth birthday, Ha-Jun. Grow strong. Be kind.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Kabhi mat bhoolna, chahe duniya tumse nafrat kare, tum mere pyare chhote bhai ho.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks into the camera lens with unconditional warmth: 'Happy tenth birthday, Ha-Jun. Grow strong. Be kind.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun bina shart garmjoshi ke saath camere ke lens mein dekhta hai: 'dasvan janamdin mubarak ho, ha-jun. majboot bano. dayalu hon.'.

panels.shot: the holographic projection glitching into static
panels.action: The 3D image fractures into cyan and red scanlines; Tae-Jun's silhouette dissolves into floating blue sparks.
panels.prose_en: The 3D image fractures into cyan and red scanlines; Tae-Jun's silhouette dissolves into floating blue sparks.
panels.prose_hi: 3d chhavi siyan aur lal scanlinon mein vibhajit ho jaati hai; taaye-jun ka chhayachitra tairti neeli chingariyon mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.shot: darkness returning to the bedroom leaving absolute silence
panels.action: The room plunges back into twilight gloom; only the gentle pitter-patter of rain outside the window remains.
panels.prose_en: The room plunges back into twilight gloom; only the gentle pitter-patter of rain outside the window remains.
panels.prose_hi: Kamra punah dhundhlake mein doob jata hai; khidki ke bahar keval baarish ki halki-halki gadgdahat hi bachi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his head from the floor with glowing violet eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun lifts his head; his tear-stained cheeks are now illuminated by eyes burning with primordial sovereign fire.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lifts his head; his tear-stained cheeks are now illuminated by eyes burning with primordial sovereign fire.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apna sir uthaya; uske aansuon se sane gaal ab aadim samprabhu agni se jalti hui aankhon se prakashit ho rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing up straight with terrifying majesty
panels.action: Ha-Jun rises to his full height; his dark coat flutters as a shockwave of compressed demonic gravity clears the dust.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rises to his full height; his dark coat flutters as a shockwave of compressed demonic gravity clears the dust.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni puri unchai tak badh jata hai; uska kala coat aise lahrata hai jaise sampidit rakshasi gurutvakarshan ki ek shockwev dhul ko saaf kar deti hai.

panels.shot: the ten relics orbiting around ha-jun in miniature ethereal forms
panels.action: Ghostly phantoms of the Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, and Crown circle his shoulders in celestial harmony.
panels.prose_en: Ghostly phantoms of the Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, and Crown circle his shoulders in celestial harmony.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh, anguthi, haddi, hridy, daant, aankh aur mukut ke bhutiya pret divya samanjasya mein uske kandhon ko gherte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun pocketing the optical disc next to his heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun carefully places the optical disc into his inner breast pocket right over his beating heart.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main aa raha hoon, Tae-Jun hyung. Main tumhe wapas launga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun carefully places the optical disc into his inner breast pocket right over his beating heart.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne dhyan se optical disk ko apne dhadkate dil ke theek upar apni aantarik chhati ki jeb mein rakha.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder with razor focus
panels.action: Kuro sharpens his talons: 'Where do we strike first, My Sovereign?'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Vault 7. Incheon underground lab. Ab hisaab lene ka waqt hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sharpens his talons: 'Where do we strike first, My Sovereign?'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne panje tez kiye: 'ham sabse pehle kahan war karen, mere prabhu?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking out the rainy window toward incheon skyline
panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes out over the neon-lit Seoul skyline toward Incheon harbor, lightning splitting the dark clouds.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Dr. Vance... Aur Chairman Song... Tumhara time khatam ho chuka hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes out over the neon-lit Seoul skyline toward Incheon harbor, lightning splitting the dark clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun nean roshni wale seoul kshitij ko inchiyon bandargah ki or dekhta hai, bijli kale baadalon ko chirti hui dikhai deti hai.
